title: IIBF IE&IFS Unit 22: Development Financial Institutions (NABARD, SIDBI, EXIM, NHB & NaBFID)
summary: Comprehensive breakdown of apex developmental banks: NABARD, SIDBI, EXIM Bank, NHB, MUDRA loans (Shishu, Kishore, Tarun, Tarun Plus), and NaBFID Act 2021.

blocks.title: IIBF Core Foundation: Specialized Term Lending Institutions
blocks.summary: Development Financial Institutions (DFIs) provide long-term, patient, concessional project financing for high-risk, long-gestation sectors (Agriculture, MSMEs, Foreign Trade, Housing, Infrastructure) where commercial banks face asset-liability mismatch (ALM).

blocks.caption: Apex All-India Financial Institutions (AIFIs)
rows: NABARD Act, 1981 (**12 July 1982**; B. Sivaraman Committee)
Apex institution for rural development, agriculture credit refinancing, supervision of RRBs/StCBs/DCCBs, and managing RIDF.
Principal DFI for promotion, financing, and development of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises (MSMEs).
Export-Import Bank of India Act, 1981 (**1 January 1982**)
Financing, facilitating, and promoting India's international trade and cross-border project exports.
Apex financial institution for housing finance; 100% owned by Govt of India (RBI divested stake in 2019).
National Bank for Financing Infrastructure and Development Act, 2021 (**2021**)
Principal DFI for infrastructure financing with ₹20,000 Cr central capital; targeted to catalyze ₹5 Lakh Cr infra loans.

blocks.text: 💰 2. Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY) Loan Categories

blocks.caption: MUDRA Loan Slabs (Refinanced via Micro Units Development & Refinance Agency)
rows: Enterprises expanding operations and buying equipment.
Loans **above ₹5 Lakh and up to ₹10 Lakh**
Established small business units scaling commercial capacity.
Loans **above ₹10 Lakh and up to ₹20 Lakh**
Entrepreneurs who have successfully repaid previous Tarun loans.

blocks.content:
🎯 Top IIBF Traps for Unit 22:
1. **SIDBI Headquarters:** Located in **Lucknow** (NOT Mumbai).
2. **MUDRA Loan Cap Enhancement:** Enhanced up to **₹20 Lakh** under the newly introduced **Tarun Plus** category.
3. **NABARD Committee:** Formulated by **B. Sivaraman Committee (CRAFICARD)** in 1979 (Established 12 July 1982).
